verdict.rationale: Subscription-lifecycle features are a fair question for an invoicing and billing product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows recurring invoices and stored-card auto-charging, which are adjacent features. Nothing documents free trials, coupons, promotion codes, trial-to-paid conversion, or trial-end notifications.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules
